implementation_boundary: This plan authorizes warehouse/world-kit foundation work only. It does not authorize opening gated Part II/III runtime chapter implementation ahead of current foundation gates.

coverage_policy.parallelism: All listed regions may advance reusable stock, materials, architecture, ecology, audio, lighting/VFX and traversal requirements in warehouse/preproduction without opening gated Part II/III runtime chapters.
coverage_policy.evidence_boundary: CANDIDATE/AUTHORIZED/STAGED/READY_FOR_IMPORT are warehouse states only. IMPORTED/INTEGRATED/ACCEPTED require their own UE/runtime/human evidence.

intake_readiness_order: Preserve provider/source/license/provenance and SHA256 receipt at staging.
Extract and inspect archives before READY_FOR_IMPORT; reject corrupt or unexpected payloads.
For animated characters/creatures require skeletal FBX, real skeleton, skin weights, deformation sanity and animation/skeleton compatibility.
For production textures prefer PNG/TGA and channel-packed masks where applicable; staged source files are not accepted materials.
Classify repeated decorative stock for ISM/HISM and explicit cull-distance use before world integration.
Keep heavy content soft/async-owned through FStreamableManager; do not turn warehouse fill into synchronous runtime loading.
Do not promote STAGED to READY_FOR_IMPORT, IMPORTED, INTEGRATED or ACCEPTED without the evidence required by each state.

source_basis: 03_WORLD_LOCATIONS_AND_MAP_BIBLE: Shire/Hobbiton pastoral hills, lanes, farms, Hobbit-holes; landmark, traversal, streaming, NPC and QA contracts.
07_MISSION_AND_CHAPTER_IMPLEMENTATION_MATRIX: F1-01 Shire onboarding/social/birthday mission package and deterministic mission-state/checkpoint rules.
09_EXTERNAL_HELPFUL_RESOURCES_BIBLE: modular-kit, provenance and per-asset validation discipline.
10_3D_VISUAL_ASSET_ATLAS_PRODUCTION: visual/modeling aid only; never overrides canon/source files.
11_MASTER_PRODUCTION_SYSTEMS_AND_SOURCE_INDEX: performance, audio, living-world and production-system contracts.
runtime_rules: Do not move stable quest/story anchors merely to create visual terrain.
Repeated non-story terrain silhouettes use HISM with explicit cull distances.
Grounding remains protected by the broad collision foundation and router grounding contract.
Sightline breaks reveal later geography through travel rather than exposing the entire route from Bag End.
No new synchronous heavy asset loading is introduced by the geography pass.
acceptance: Exact-head Pre-Unreal and UE4.27.2 core lane green.
P1C01 owner PIE confirms grounding/traversal/collision remains stable after terrain pass.
Human visual review confirms at least one dominant Hobbiton/Bag End vista and readable route progression.
Target-device profiling precedes any density increase.
